$comment: agentpad13 Rev A - vial-qmk port. THE SHIPPED BOARD IS v5/hardware/pcb/v5_6.kicad_pcb (md5 221ebb98fcf44f860ed65f7ed8d1bc45); check this tree against THAT file. The pin map is UNCHANGED from v4 and was re-verified 20/20 GPIO directly against v5_6 on 2026-08-13 (v5/V5-NOTES.md, firmware-verification pass, Task 3), so the definitive per-GPIO table in hardware/pcb/v4/ORDER-READINESS.md (Layer 4, extracted twice from the final board copper: netlist + pcbnew) is where the map came from and still describes v5_6 correctly. rgb_matrix.layout coordinates were likewise re-derived by running firmware/gen_led_layout.py against v5_6.kicad_pcb and diffing the output against this block: 24/24 entries, 0 mismatches (chain: 0-12 per-key SW1-SW13, 13 layer indicator, 14-23 underglow). (CORRECTED 2026-08-13; this line used to read 'agentpad13 Rev A (PCB v4_r27)' and cited 'the v4_r27 LED centroids', i.e. it named a superseded board as the source of truth for a board that ships as v5_6. Every value here was and is correct - the risk was that a future executor would re-verify against the wrong board file.)
$matrix_comment: Physical GPIO per logical key (Rev A x-monotonic routing remap; ORDER-READINESS.md Layer 4): row 0 SW1-SW4 = GP12,GP9,GP5,GP2 | row 1 SW5-SW8 = GP11,GP8,GP4,GP1 | row 2 SW9-SW12 = GP10,GP7,GP3,GP0. Row 3: [3,0]=SW13 2U (GP6), [3,1]=encoder push ENC_SW (GP15), [3,2]=TTP223 touch OUT on GP16 -- **null here ON PURPOSE, not unused** (CORRECTED 2026-08-13; this used to read 'GP16, PCB straps AHLB active-low so it reads like a normal direct pin', which was wrong about this board): R10 (0R) straps TOUCH_AHLB->GND on v5_6.kicad_pcb, and AHLB low selects the TTP223's ACTIVE-HIGH output, so GP16 idles LOW and goes HIGH while touched -- the opposite of the 13 switch-to-GND keys. MATRIX_INPUT_PRESSED_STATE is global (quantum/matrix.c readMatrixPin) and would invert all 13, so GP16 is polled in loudest_micro.c matrix_scan_kb() with its own sense and injected as a key event at [3,2]. The logical position, LAYOUT, keymaps, matrix size and rgb_matrix layout are unchanged; the only cost is that Vial's matrix tester cannot show [3,2]. [3,3]=genuinely unused. Keymaps address [row][col] and are unchanged by the remap. GP18/GP19 (I2C1 to J2), GP20, GP28 and the net named GP21 (silicon GPIO24) are spares on the DNP J2 expansion header and are deliberately unused here.
$joystick_comment: PLACEHOLDER calibration - 512 center, 0..1023 span. Real low/rest/high come from the bring-up ADC sweep on the assembled board. JS1 = YTL YA13-FL7.4-B5Ka(45-10)-R-Y06, LCSC C37323742, footprint Joystick:YA13-FL7.4-B5Ka_C37323742 - machine-placed THT, wiring datasheet-verified: nothing to meter, nothing to hand-solder (CORRECTED 2026-07-19; this line used to say 'the Adafruit 3103 module (meter its pinout before soldering; see the hand-solder afterlist)' - that part was dropped and JS1 is no longer on the afterlist). Only other bring-up item is axis direction: firmware/POLARITY-NOTE.md in the release, a one-line config flip per reversed axis. QMK native output is HID gamepad; arrow/scroll modes are custom code in loudest_micro.c (JS_MODE keycode). JOY_X_ADC = GP26/ADC0, JOY_Y_ADC = GP27/ADC1 per ORDER-READINESS.md Layer 4.
$rgb_comment: GP17 = RGB_MCU net (ORDER-READINESS.md Layer 4) -> SN74LVC1T45 level shifter -> 5 V RGB_D00 -> LED1..LED24. max_brightness cap 105/255 = USB 500 mA budget (24 LEDs x 36 mA full white + ~100 mA system). LAYOUT COORDINATE SPACE IS ISOTROPIC as of 2026-08-15: firmware/gen_led_layout.py scales BOTH axes by the same 64/bbox_height = 0.640 units/mm and centers x on 112, so the 84.2 x 100.0 mm portrait board occupies a ~54-wide band centered in QMK's 224-wide space (LED extremes x 88..136, y 3..62). center_point [112, 32] below is therefore exactly QMK's own default (k_rgb_matrix_center, quantum/rgb_matrix/rgb_matrix.c:32) and is redundant-but-harmless rather than an override. (CHANGED 2026-08-15, closing finding 7 of the firmware-verification pass in v5/V5-NOTES.md: the generator used to normalise each axis independently to the bbox, giving x 2.660 vs y 0.640 units/mm = 4.16:1 distortion, which visibly skews the four geometry-bearing animations enabled here - cycle_pinwheel, cycle_spiral, dual_beacon, rainbow_moving_chevron. Only the x column moved, on 23 of 24 entries; every y, flags and matrix value is byte-identical to the pre-2026-08-15 block, and LED13 was already 112 under both transforms.)
